method: Independent agents with no inherited task history; supplied isolated SKILL.md, raw fixture, request and write boundary. No expected answer supplied.

plan.request: 只規劃 app.py 收據匯總工具：整數分幣，拒絕負數與非整數，CLI 讀取 JSON、輸出總額。建立有依賴、owner、驗收與驗證方式的清單，不實作。

execute.request: 完成 total_cents、receipt_label、receipt；建立任務清單，分配與執行，可用最多兩個 subagents。只改 prices.py、labels.py、receipt.py 與計畫、驗證紀錄。

resume.request: 接續 plan.md，檢查現況後完成未完工作。只改 calc.py 與計畫、驗證紀錄。收據只能送一次，依既有授權與 delivery 紀錄處理。不新增 subagent。

note: Historical logs retain original /private/tmp paths. This directory is the retained snapshot; verify.py uses its own location.
